measurement_scope: Actual recorded steering commands, not measured road-wheel angle or tire force.

definitions.total_variation: Sum absolute consecutive recorded command differences; exact at50Hz, lower bound when downsampled.
definitions.highpass: Offline third-order zero-phase1Hz high-pass used for measurement only, never an online filtering proposal.
definitions.steering_acceleration: Finite difference of command rate divided by the mean adjacent interval; unitsrad/s², no measured tire-force claim.
definitions.direction_change: New steering extremum confirmed after opposite excursion>=.005rad, cadence-independent.
definitions.stable_regime: Excludes±.3s around sampled method, geometry or planned-mode changes; does not assert absence of nearby traffic.
definitions.fixed_anchors: 18 predeclared original-reference curvature peaks from prior calibration audit; unreached anchors remain explicitly unobserved.

prior_downsampled_clear_context.label: prior10
prior_downsampled_clear_context.comparison_scope: Cadence context only; not a candidate treatment or physical improvement.

redactions: Absolute run locations and raw input hash-location indices omitted.
